final: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Bytes AS REAL)/Milliseconds END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean FROM a WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(n) AS avg_track_count, AVG(rate - (SELECT mean FROM m)) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE rate > (SELECT mean FROM m)
